notes: No project selected. Run of 2026-09-23 was a selection run (Outcome E): 30 candidates generated and recorded in IDEAS.md, 8 searches run, 4 candidates killed on prior art with links, 1 provisional winner shortlisted in IDEAS.md section 5. Nothing is selected and nothing may be built from that shortlist until it survives a cold re-read at the start of the next run, per the sleep-on-it rule. The checklist above is the template for the next project; for a multi-run project, fill in definition_of_done and milestones before implementation starts, per Gate D. Read IDEAS.md before generating any new candidate.

selection_in_progress.provisional_hook_sentence: Grab the answer and drag it, and the numbers that produced it rearrange themselves to agree.
killed_on_prior_art_this_run: linkage that traces a curve you drew
minimal-conflict explainer for over-constrained CAD sketches

selection_in_progress.blocking_question: Does any shipped tool already offer continuous dragging of any variable in a general nonlinear model with least-change semantics? Acausal modelling tools are the sharpest risk. One search was run and found the academic lineage and Goal Seek but no such tool; that is not enough.
next_run_must: Re-read IDEAS.md section 5 cold before anything else and say plainly whether it still holds.
If it holds, finish the prior-art search named in that entry.
Only then write NOVELTY_REPORT.md, definition_of_done and a milestone ladder.
Milestone 1 must be a vertical slice: the exposure-triangle demo, draggable, in a browser.
If it dies, move it to IDEAS.md section 2 with links and return to generation.
